comment: Predicates in the datum frame (origin = cup axis x rim plane, +Z out of the rim, +X toward the handle). Functional interfaces are the four named in intake/INTAKE_CARD.md §4; the regime (baseline-skill) has no interface band (interface_max_mm null), so they are REPORTED per zone, not separately gated. Spout axes at theta 56.3 / -56.8 deg, spacing 30.02 mm (INTAKE_CARD §5 row 7, MEASUREMENTS request F04) => r ~18.0.

zones.name: RIM
zones.note: rim end face z=0 incl. lug tops (gasket seat, datum primary)

zones.name: LUGS
zones.note: 3 bayonet lugs: outer radius and ramped under-faces (59.5/180/300.5 deg)

zones.name: BORE
zones.note: rim bore and basket ledge (z~-11.5); z window stops below the wire arcs

zones.name: SPOUTS
zones.note: two spout bosses, pan-head screw heads and tips (simplified heads, owner PART-CLASS)

zones.name: INSERT_FLOOR
zones.note: black pressurised insert: funnel floor, U rib, V ribs, 2 outlet pockets; rib flanks and pocket interiors partly occluded/unscanned

zones.name: WIRE
zones.note: retaining wire spring arcs seen through the bore (ends dive out of sight)

zones.name: CENTRE_SCREW
zones.note: centre screw with cross recess on the bottom

zones.name: CUP_OUTER
zones.note: drafted cup outer wall away from the neck/pad
